title: Laughter Chefs 3: Nia Sharma Claims Aly Goni-Samarth Jurel Have 'Zero Civic Sense' | Television News - News18
text: Laughter Chefs: Unlimited Entertainment Season 3 is all set to bring back the fun and frenzy as its much-loved OG contestants return to the kitchen. With the intense rivalry between Team Kaanta and Team Chhurri coming to an end, familiar faces — Sudesh Lehri, Ankita Lokhande, Vicky Jain, Arjun Bijlani, and Nia Sharma — are back to shake things up and add a dose of nostalgia and banter to the show. As excitement around the upcoming episodes builds, several behind-the-scenes clips from the sets have been going viral on social media. One such video has caught fans’ attention, featuring Nia Sharma, Sudesh Lehri, Aly Goni, and Samarth Jurel in a light-hearted moment. Nia Sharma’s ‘Zero Civic Sense’ Call Out In the clip, Nia Sharma and Sudesh Lehri are seen posing together and making a heart sign while clicking a picture. However, Aly Goni and Samarth Jurel humorously step in and mimic their pose from behind, instantly triggering laughter among those present. When Nia turns around and notices the duo copying them, she jokingly yells, “Zero civic sense," before laughing and walking away. Nia Sharma On Returning To Laughter Chefs: Unlimited Entertainment Known for her fearless energy, Nia Sharma told the Times of India, “Laughter Chefs marks a milestone in my life because it gave me a direct bond with the audience beyond fiction shows. Sometimes, wherever I go, people come up to me and say, ‘Maine aapko Laughter Chefs mein dekha hai,’ and honestly, that fills my eyes with tears. It makes me realise how deeply this show has touched people’s lives and mine too." “This platform has given me so much love and acceptance. And of course, watching audiences enjoy my nok-jhok with Sudesh ji is still my favourite part. Being back here feels like coming back to where I truly belong," she added. Laughter Chefs: Unlimited Entertainment Season 3 Inspired by the Tamil hit Cooku With Comali, Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment has become a fan favourite with its unique blend of comedy, celebrity chaos, and cooking challenges. This season features a star-studded lineup including Krushna Abhishek, Kashmera Shah, Karan Kundrra, Arjun Bijlani, Aly Goni, Jannat Zubair, Sudesh Lehri, Nia Sharma, Ankita Lokhande and Vicky Jain. What’s Nia Sharma Currently Working On? Meanwhile, Nia Sharma is winning over fans as a mischief-maker on the dating-based reality show MTV Splitsvilla X6. Hosted by Sunny Leone and Karan Kundrra, the show follows young men and women as they form connections, perform tasks, and battle eliminations.
